_about.source: Real TUIs run in a 100x30 pty (env scrubbed to HOME/PATH/TERM/LANG), every output byte recorded, then rendered through the daemon's own generateTextSnapshot. Captured 2026-09-28. Rows trimmed to the bottom of the grid; status-line, account, banner and path rows removed. `title` is the last OSC 0/2 title at that moment and `ageMs` how long before it was set.
_about.titleCadence: While a turn runs Claude rewrites its title every ~0.96 s (max gap 0.98 s), Codex every ~0.1 s (max gap 0.2 s).

titleOnlyEvidence.claude-streaming: answer text streaming: no spinner row, title spinner up
titleOnlyEvidence.claude-starting: first second: spinner row without its counter, title spinner up
titleOnlyEvidence.codex-streaming: answer text streaming: no status row, title spinner up

noEvidence.claude-interrupted: after one ESC: title back to the idle mark
noEvidence.codex-interrupted: after one ESC: spinner gone from the title
